# Release binaries

The current launcher APK and large build dependencies are attached to GitHub Releases:
https://github.com/undeads30/projector-launcher/releases/tag/v2.1.0

Download LauncherTV-2.1.0.apk for installation. To build sources, run launcher/download-dependencies.ps1 first; all downloads are checked against DEPENDENCIES.sha256. Smaller companion APK/JAR files are retained here for convenience. Historical launcher APK remains available in tag v2.0.0.
